name: ai-fxb-site
description: 3ecat.me 单仓:根路由是简历,子路由 /ai-fxb 是 AI 窗口情报控制台,/learn 是教案与课件(公开课件 + 加密私密区)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ai-fxb/core && npm run build --workspace resume-react && npm run build --workspace @ai-fxb/console && npm run build --workspace @ai-fxb/learn && node scripts/assemble.mjs
scripts.dev:resume: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace resume-react
scripts.dev:console: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @ai-fxb/console
scripts.dev:learn:private: npm run learn:data && npm run dev --workspace @ai-fxb/learn
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-fxb/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-fxb/console && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-fxb/learn
